wiki.title: Kevin Ritter
wiki.extract: Kevin Ritter (born August 5, 1967) is an American politician and teacher serving as a member of the Ohio House of Representatives for the 94th district. He won the seat after incumbent Republican Jay Edwards became term-limited after completing his fourth term in 2024. He defeated Democrat Wenda Sheard in 2024, winning 69.3% to 30.7%. A member of the Republican Party, Ritter previously served as a Washington County Commissioner from 2019 to 2024.
